title: Evidence-grounded homework generation and validation
goal: Compose a usable homework draft from learner evidence and reviewed material.
rationale: Generation should serve the teaching need while preserving objective, provenance and correctness.
scope: Initial concise draft; specification only, no implementation or acceptance claimed. Homework only. Sources: PD-09/10/12–17/35/37; Architecture sections 2/7. Lesson planning, urgent replanning and unrelated original exercise authoring are excluded. PD-39/40 extend on-request current/revisit selection and non-error teaching routes; no background scheduling, student app or automated audio assessment.

depends_on.reason: Needs eligible reviewed material and provenance.

requirement.title: Evidence-grounded homework generation and validation
requirement.statement: Use both available recent lesson/homework evidence streams, current goals and qualified cumulative context to select explained important-now/worth-revisiting objectives, then reuse/adapt reviewed assets and compose timed homework. Adapt preferred domains without silently relaxing hard requirements. Keep student content separate from the tutor guide and block safety, validity or unsupported-fact failures. Permit accessible input, vocabulary exposure, fluency, discourse models, strategies and meaningful tasks/projects from reviewed assets/frameworks without inventing deficits. Each route needs purpose/outcome, appropriate demands/support and suitable criteria; exposure or drill accuracy cannot prove unrelated outcomes. Preserve frozen recent/history references, independent fact intake and no fixed current/review quota.

scenarios.given: A tutor requests homework with learner evidence, eligible assets and a duration.
scenarios.when: The workflow prepares and validates a draft.
scenarios.then: The draft explains its objectives, fits the planned duration, preserves sources and provides separate student instructions and a tutor guide.
scenarios.verification: Future complete preparation observation with reviewed inputs and tutor rubric.

scenarios.given: An adaptation has a wrong/ambiguous answer, unsupported learner claim or unmet hard requirement.
scenarios.then: The affected material requires correction/removal and cannot become an approved ready artifact.
scenarios.verification: Future seeded-defect cases through the actual validation boundary.

scenarios.given: No eligible reviewed asset can meet a required objective.
scenarios.then: It exposes the gap or a useful tutor choice instead of inventing an exercise/reference or silently changing the objective.

scenarios.given: A tutor supplies a supported non-error learning goal, suitable reviewed material/framework and a duration.
scenarios.when: Homework is prepared for each enabled PD-40 route.
scenarios.then: Produce purposeful input/practice/task sections with accessibility/support and route-specific criteria, timings, provenance and tutor review; invent no weakness or original unrelated task. Missing eligible recording/material/criteria remains a gap.
scenarios.verification: Future reviewed route-level and complete-job cases for reading, listening, vocabulary, fluency, discourse, strategies and project/task adaptation.

scenarios.given: A current goal is important and older confirmed work may be worth revisiting; readiness for a task prerequisite is uncertain.
scenarios.when: Objective selection balances the requested duration and constraints.
scenarios.then: Explain important-now/revisit choices using frozen goal/evidence/history references with no fixed quota. Use support, a lighter checked task or a useful recheck for uncertainty; time alone proves no forgetting, exposure no mastery and older history changes no recent denominator.
scenarios.verification: Future fixed-history objective/priority cases with old encounters, assignment-only records, uncertain prerequisites and unchanged arithmetic.

scenarios.given: A draft is generated, revised, approved or copied against frozen activity/history evidence.
scenarios.when: The preparation/review path persists its result.
scenarios.then: Only request/draft/decision records change; assignment, encounters, attempts and checked outcomes require separate supplied/confirmed intake. New history evidence requires a new request.
scenarios.verification: Future before/after activity/observation row comparisons and frozen-snapshot revision checks.

tasks.description: Produce evidence-linked objectives and source-preserving homework adaptations.
Compose separate student/tutor content and apply part/plan validation gates.
